title: calyptridium paniculatum
intro: Calyptridium paniculatum, commonly known as Mountain Star or Starry Wintergreen, is a species of flowering plant in the family Portulacaceae. It is used in herbal medicine for its potential health benefits, which include anti-inflammatory and antioxidant properties that may help alleviate symptoms of anxiety and stress. The plant contains bioactive constituents such as flavonoids, alkaloids, and saponins, which contribute to its medicinal properties.
